author: Inside Edition
description: A 4-year-old boy fell into the family pool and his mother sprang into action. It happened in Miami where several kids were hanging out. Little Alec ran around the pool when he lost his footing and fell into the water. His 9-year-old sister Anne Marie grabbed his hand to keep him afloat. Mom bypassed the pool stairs and was airborne as she jumped into the pool. She boosted him out of the water and dad picked him up. It took place a year ago but Crystal Castalano recently shared it as a warning to parents for Memorial Day weekend. She spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Mom Makes Huge Leap To Save 4-Year-Old Son Who Fell In Pool

author: Inside Edition
description: Fears of Ebola triggered panic on board a flight from Paris to Detroit. An Air France jet with 261 passengers was ordered to divert in midair to Montreal. Passenger Deborah Mistor shot video from inside the plane. There was one traveler on board from the Congo, which is in the grip of an Ebola outbreak. US authorities refused the plane permission to land in Detroit, but the sight of flight attendants in masks caused panic. The flight was allowed to continue to Detroit once that passenger had been taken off.
title: Fears Of Ebola Trigger Panic On Board Flight

author: Inside Edition
description: Cuban-Americans celebrated what they say is a long-awaited first step toward justice. The United States announced an indictment against former Cuban president Raul Castro and five others, for their alleged roles in connection with shooting down of planes in 1996, killing four American nationals. The aircraft were operated by Brothers to the Rescue, an organization that helped Cubans leave the country. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: U.S. Indicts Former Cuban President Raul Castro For Murder

author: Inside Edition
description: Scientists think they've figured out a great pre-historic mystery: how did the Tyrannosaurus rex grow to be so big, while maintaining teeny tiny arms? A new study by British researchers suggests that all the nutrition this dinosaur consumed went to the body parts that needed to be the biggest and strongest. Unfortunately for T. rex, that didn't include its arms. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Scientists Believe This Is Why T. Rex Had Tiny Arms
